metadata.rust: rustc 1.99.1, LLVM 23.1.1, release, -C target-cpu=x86-64-v3, strict FP, runtime Pulp V3
metadata.threads: q8 pinned to physical CPUs 0-7; Rust Rayon and DUCC worker pools reused within process
metadata.protocol: 3 interleaved independent process pairs; each process did one warmup, 5 individually timed warm calls (each operation >100 ms); outputs compared after each pair; first-call times retained separately
metadata.validation: The timed deterministic full-order analysis outputs were compared after every pair. The harness post-timing edge-case sidecar sweep was omitted for this rebaseline; production exceptional-value and adjoint coverage had passed the full release test suites at source commit 140b4bff, and this change only affects inverse synthesis.
metadata.fixture: Existing native full-transform harness fixture formula, phi0=0.23; lmax=mmax=3072; GL ntheta=3073, nphi=6174 even-smooth.
metadata.contention: Per-process runqueue-wait fractions and involuntary context switches are retained in summary.json. Rust runs recorded 240-453 involuntary switches vs DUCC 63-83; scheduling noise is material and source comparisons are directional. Per-run CPU-frequency/PSI snapshots were not retained.
